validation_dataset.indexing: state45[i,t] = raw float64 (qpos23, qvel22). Interval j=0..49 goes from state j to j+1; applied16[i,j] drove that interval; issued16 and policy_raw16 were computed at its start. support_mask, wheel speeds, body_vx_m_s, pitch_rad and last_torque_nm are observed at its end. range_features16 is the causal, delayed 16-vector available to the actor at interval start.
validation_dataset.support_definition: FL,FR,RL,RR contacts at or beyond the 0.60 m toe carrying greater than 1 N at the endpoint.
validation_dataset.split: Evaluation only. A whole reset and all its policies, arms and derived windows form one group. These three previously used reset states are excluded from world-model fitting and normalization.
